description: Figure 7 is a grouped bar chart that compares the performance of mBERT and XLM-RoBERTa models across different language families. The horizontal axis lists nine language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "task count," ranges from 0 to 40. For each language family, there are three bars representing the number of tasks where mBERT performed better (light blue), XLM-R performed better (dark blue), or the performance was the same (light green). The legend in the top right corner clarifies the color coding. The chart shows that XLM-R generally outperforms mBERT in most language families, with the most significant difference observed in the IE-Slavic family, where XLM-R has a task count of approximately 39, compared to mBERT's count of about 12. In contrast, mBERT performs better in the IE-Germanic family, where it has a count of about 4, while XLM-R has a count of about 18. The "same" category is the most frequent outcome for both models in the IE-Indic, IE-Romance, and IE-Slavic families.
